rev.t: I ordered from Art of Delight late at night, and I was really impressed with both the quality and the service. My order was delivered in a timely manner, even though it was a late-night order. …

Had ordered hot chocolate fudge icream sundae from art of delight bellandur. It was too good , loved it. The taste was so soothing , not too sweet , had the perfect balance of cream , sweet and chocolate. Thank you Riya for the dessert and for sending the hand written note. Will order again for sure !

Thank you  Jangnu 🫶 for serving us such delicious desserts at 10 pm. It was such a wholesome moment for us to enjoy the dessert with extra toppings and such creative presentation and too notch taste
The whole family enjoyed it a lottt . …
